mockPay.banner: TEST PAGE — a replica of the Euronet payment page. It takes no card details and nothing is charged.
mockPay.footnote: Once Euronet issues AcquirerId/MerchantId/PosId/Username/Password, Paycenter pay.aspx replaces this page — the rest of the flow (ticketing, HashKey verification) stays the same.

epayPage.disclaimer: Entering your name and email enhances the security of transactions in accordance with the schemes' guidelines (e.g. Visa, Mastercard). This information will be transferred to the Bank that issued your card. For further details, please refer to epay's <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
epayPage.bankSelectLead: Select your Bank and you will be automatically redirected to your Bank's secure e-banking environment to complete your payment. Once the payment is completed, you will be automatically redirected back to the merchant's website.
epayPage.qrLead: Go to your bank's mobile banking app, scan the QR code below and complete the payment. Once the payment is completed, you will be automatically redirected back to the merchant's website.
epayPage.qrPlaceholder: The QR code is generated by IRIS at payment time.

payments.secureNote: Payments are taken only inside the secure environment of Euronet Merchant Services (epay), with 3-D Secure strong cardholder authentication. We never see or store your card details.

security.title: Payment security
security.lead: Casa Playa's online payments run through the epay eCommerce (Redirection) service of Euronet Merchant Services.
security.threeDsBody: Every transaction is protected by Visa Secure and Mastercard Identity Check. The bank that issued your card may ask you for an extra confirmation before the payment completes.
security.dataBody: Card details are entered only on the Euronet Merchant Services payment page, over an encrypted connection. They never pass through our servers, are never stored, and are never visible to us.
security.confirmBody: The bank's response is cryptographically verified (HashKey) before a booking is marked as paid, so it cannot be forged.

payHandoff.title: Going to secure payment
payHandoff.body: We're taking you to the bank's payment page. Please don't close this window.

policy.nonRefundable: Non-refundable booking. In case of cancellation, no-show or late arrival (after 12:00) a 100% charge applies.
